sourceStrategy: Static mirror of LayerLibrary JSON ingestion and LayerFactory registration checks.
Package entries are appended from draft layer.package.json discovery output.
This combined view is a compatibility check only; runtime loading still uses legacy layer JSON unless changed in app code.

packageDiscovery.coexistenceRule: Layer packages are discovered from package roots. Legacy *.json layer assets remain the runtime catalog source until package loading is explicitly enabled; duplicate asset IDs between the two surfaces are treated as conflicts by combined checks.

roots.purpose: Tracked example packages used by docs, schemas, and regression tests.
